title: hunk-guide guide
description: An ordered semantic walkthrough for reviewing a changeset in Hunk. Section and target IDs must be unique within the guide, and a guide may contain at most 500 targets in total; these aggregate constraints are enforced when hunk-guide loads the file.

$schema.description: JSON Schema URI used by editors for completion and validation.

id.description: Stable guide ID. Keep this unchanged when updating the same guide.

title.description: Optional title shown at the top of the Guide pane.

summary.description: Optional overview of the changeset's narrative.

sections.description: Review sections in presentation order. Use no more than 500 targets across all sections.

id.description: Stable section ID, unique among sections in this guide.

kind.description: Review purpose. Defaults to change. Use verification for tests and benchmarks, supporting for secondary context, and mechanical for generated or bulk edits.

title.description: Short description of the logical change covered by this section.

explanation.description: Why this section matters and what the reviewer should notice.

targets.description: Changed source ranges to review in order.

id.description: Stable target ID, unique among all targets in this guide.

path.description: Repository-relative path. For old-side targets, use the file's path before a rename.

side.description: Side of the diff containing the target range. Defaults to new.

startLine.description: First line of the target range, using 1-based inclusive source coordinates.

endLine.description: Last line of the target range, inclusive. Defaults to startLine and must not be less than startLine.

symbol.description: Optional symbol name reserved for future target reconciliation.
